intentEvidence: This is a plugin for Obsidian ( to import highlights that you made on your Pocketbook E-Ink reader, or in the Pocketbook App on your phone, using a Pocketbook Cloud account.
problem: Users lack a mechanism to transfer and organize highlights and notes captured on Pocketbook e-ink readers into Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Requires the "dataview" plugin to work correctly

summary: Imports notes and highlights from Pocketbook Cloud into Obsidian Markdown files, structuring them with YAML frontmatter and Dataview queries.
